question: The speed of sound _______ as it passes from solid to gaseous medium.
solution:
The correct answer is **decreases**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Speed of sound** is affected by the medium through which it travels.
 
• In a **solid medium**, particles are closely packed, allowing sound waves to travel faster.
 
• In a **gaseous medium**, particles are spread out, causing sound waves to travel slower.
 
• Thus, as sound passes from a solid to a gaseous medium, its speed **decreases**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
